info.title: bellaboot
info.description: CLI tool for scaffolding Umbraco Bellissima (v14+) packages.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: BellaBoot — scaffold Umbraco Bellissima packages from the terminal

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help and usage information

options.name: --version
options.description: Show version information

commands.name: new
commands.description: Scaffold a new Umbraco Bellissima package project

options.name: --output
options.description: Target directory (defaults to current directory)

options.name: --author
options.description: Package author name

options.name: --backend-only
options.description: No backoffice UI — scaffold only the backend NuGet package [default: False]

commands.name: target
commands.description: Spin up an Umbraco test instance for your package

options.name: --output
options.description: Package root directory (defaults to current directory)

options.name: --models-mode
options.description: Umbraco models generation mode [default: SourceCodeAuto]

options.name: --email
options.description: Default admin email [default: admin@example.com]

options.name: --password
options.description: Default admin password [default: 1234567890]

options.name: --friendly-name
options.description: Default admin display name [default: Administrator]

arguments.name: VERSION
arguments.description: Umbraco version to target: Latest, LTS, or a semver string (e.g. 17.3.4)

commands.name: dist-usync
commands.description: Distribute a uSync folder across all Umbraco targets

options.name: --output
options.description: Package root directory (defaults to current directory)

arguments.name: SOURCE
arguments.description: Instance to use as source (e.g. 17.3.5). Defaults to the one with the newest uSync files.

commands.name: nuget
commands.description: Pack the backend as a local NuGet and spin up (or update) an Umbraco test instance that installs it

options.name: --output
options.description: Package root directory (defaults to current directory)

options.name: --models-mode
options.description: Umbraco models generation mode [default: SourceCodeAuto]

options.name: --email
options.description: Default admin email [default: admin@example.com]

options.name: --password
options.description: Default admin password [default: 1234567890]

options.name: --friendly-name
options.description: Default admin display name [default: Administrator]

arguments.name: VERSION
arguments.description: Umbraco version to target: Latest, LTS, or a semver string (e.g. 17.3.4)

commands.name: dev
commands.description: Start dotnet watch + vite watch pointed at a live Umbraco instance

options.name: --frontend-only
options.description: Only run vite watch — skip dotnet watch (useful when running Umbraco in the VS debugger) [default: False]

options.name: --output
options.description: Package root directory (defaults to current directory)

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Stream raw process output instead of the filtered event log [default: False]

options.name: --no-generate
options.description: Do not regenerate the typed API client when the backend contract changes [default: False]

options.name: --open
options.description: Open the backoffice in the browser once Umbraco is listening [default: False]

arguments.name: VERSION
arguments.description: Umbraco target folder to use (e.g. 17.3.5). Defaults to latest or prompts if multiple exist.

commands.name: generate
commands.description: Regenerate the typed API client from a running Umbraco instance's OpenAPI spec

options.name: --output
options.description: Package root directory (defaults to current directory)

arguments.name: VERSION
arguments.description: Umbraco instance to read the OpenAPI spec from (e.g. 17.3.5). Defaults to latest or prompts if multiple exist.

commands.name: publish
commands.description: Bump the backend version, pack a Release build, and push it to NuGet

options.name: --output
options.description: Package root directory (defaults to current directory)

options.name: --minor
options.description: Bump the minor version instead of the patch version [default: False]

options.name: --major
options.description: Bump the major version instead of the patch version [default: False]

options.name: --no-bump
options.description: Publish the current version without bumping [default: False]

options.name: --api-key
options.description: NuGet API key (defaults to the NUGET_API_KEY environment variable)

options.name: --source
options.description: NuGet source to push to [default: https://api.nuget.org/v3/index.json]

options.name: --yes
options.description: Skip the confirmation prompt [default: False]

commands.name: list
commands.description: List Umbraco test instances in this package project

options.name: --output
options.description: Package root directory (defaults to current directory)

options.name: --output
options.description: Package root directory (defaults to current directory)

options.name: --yes
